propositions: The completion verifier returns a Dep record instead of CompletionVerdict because tolerant_parse selects the first parseable JSON object, not the first schema-valid one.

When show_ticket returns raw JSON containing dependency records quoted in the verifier's prose, those records precede the actual verdict in document order and are incorrectly selected as the structured output.
The schema-blind selection policy is deliberate and shared by all rebar LLM gates (plan-review, ticket-digest, overlap, epic-bug-screen), making it a verification contract, not a wiring bug.

The fix requires schema-filtered candidate selection in parse_structured with last-valid-wins strategy, an unambiguous payload channel (sentinel markers), and atomic shipment with directive changes to remain caller-safe.

Five prior recurrences of schema-blind selection failure (67ee, artsy-chain-hold, dash-lure-slag, slit-rubble-braid) prove the defect is architectural: typed payloads recovered from untyped channels via positional heuristics.
